title: Xor register: First qualifying slip
topics: Recursion, sorting, binary search and bits
summary: Maintain a register initially 0. XOR each nonnegative reading into it and record the register after each reading. Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index.
descriptionMd:
A switch register toggles each indicated punch position as the ribbon advances. Luz needs the first qualifying slip while the courier waits at the door. Later matches must not jump ahead in the tray.

Maintain a register initially 0. XOR each nonnegative reading into it and record the register after each reading.

Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index.

Implement xorRegisterFirstQualifyingSlip(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Prefix bit state. Maintain a register initially 0. XOR each nonnegative reading into it and record the register after each reading. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with prefix bit state. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Maintain a register initially 0. XOR each nonnegative reading into it and record the register after each reading. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,4,3,3,15]. Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index. This gives 7.
The derived sequence is [4,0,2,6]. Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is []. Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index. This gives -1.

overview: Combine: Prefix bit state. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
